text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One winter evening, after training...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you have anything planned
for
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Well then,
I will hang out with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And so, farewell!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask for the details after that. Then
comes the
next day...
choice_data_list: What about the time and place?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well, well! You're quite early, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well obviously! I am a model student
after all!
choice_data_list: I figured you'd arrive early, Baku...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decided to meet at 11 a.m. It's 10
a.m. right
now.
choice_data_list: Still, isn't an hour early a bit much?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The early bird gets the worm! Let us
depart at
once!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. I understand not being able
to wait,
but there's no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I have read up on the proper way to
spend the
holidays just for today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! That's what it said in the
magazine
my classmate was reading!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And if there's a proper way, then the
only thing
left to do is to test it for
ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I have my concerns as to
exactly what was in the magazine her
classmate was reading, I
decide to follow
her without saying a word.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
First up is lunch! There's a shop around
here I
have my eye on...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, there it is! The brick oven Italian
restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The place really has that Italian vibe!
It's great
that it's a hidden spot too, since
there aren't
many people around.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll be fine!
Let's have lunch at
once!
choice_data_list: Isn't it because it's still too early?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Time to order!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmm! ♪ That sure was tasty!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That dessert we got off the hidden menu
was
really sweet!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe the fact I'm class
representative was no
secret to them,
after all?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
They served it on a heart-shaped plate...

meaning, the server trusted me to
handle it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Next up is shopping! Um, do you have
any shops
in mind?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Neither of us are really looking for
anything, huh?
Let's just go to the
places the magazine
suggested.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, we do some window shopping
around a variety store that sells holiday
ornaments. When we're done, we also
check out the light display at
night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All in all, we spend the whole day
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After having some dinner with her...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What a day! We had so much fun! Don't
you think
the itinerary for today was
really up to snuff?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And now for the perfect end to round
off a
perfect day! What did the
magazine say to do
again?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes! Let us embrace under the starry
sky!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, embrace?! H-huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But that's what the magazine said! Am I
missing
something?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back on today, everything was
pretty
date-like today.
choice_data_list: Wait, was today's route actually a...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A date?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All this time, I've been on a date with
you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A date?! No way, no way, no waaay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To think, I, a class representative, would
sully our
camaraderie!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I, Sakura Bakushin O, have ruined this
day!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whatever shall I do? How can I show my
face to
my classmates again?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What if I am sentenced tomorrow to be
paraded
about the academy grounds as
a criminal?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What if I get deemed a bad class
representative
as punishment for
betraying their trust?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What now, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ohhh!
choice_data_list: Not a single student was getting c...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I ended up spending the
holidays
with Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, there shouldn't be a thing to worry
about!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Since it's you and me, Trainer, I know
there's
nothing impure about us.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I would call what we have the
purest of
camaraderies!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, as class representative,
hugging is out of the question. But I
have prepared a little
something as
replacement!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here! It's a pocket book!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O's present is a planner
that's
perfect for scheduling.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be useful, since the new
year's
around the corner and all! See, I'm
a pretty
attentive class rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Every race I plan to enter is already
written down
there for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I flick through the diary, I see "G1,
G1, G1",
over and over. It is crammed
full of races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I think that's every race I've got my eye
on, but
I've put your plans down as well!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And canceling anything that's written
down is a
super-duper no-go! Here's to
another Bakushin
year with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! It's this late already?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class representative, I must not break
curfew!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let us Bakushin, Trainer! This time, I'll
pull you
along as a treat!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Here, grab my hand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And so, our fun but rowdy winter
evening draws
to a close.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: LET'S BAKUSHIIIN!
